about: Every end-to-end regression check GoIDEA runs, the feature it protects, the doc that describes it, and the gate that must pass before code lands. scripts/check-regression-index.py keeps the ids in sync with scripts/e2e-checks.py, so a check cannot be dropped or renamed silently.

pr.when: every pull request and every push

main.when: a merge or push to main
steps: scripts/e2e.sh offline: real openidea-server, real Maven build and run
main.runs_in: .github/workflows/ci.yml (e2e job, macOS, gated by the ENABLE_MACOS_CI variable)

steps: scripts/e2e.sh online: toolchain install, JDT language server, debugger
